finite_theorem.statement: Up to order-preserving variable renaming, every legitimate canonical root with frozen input size N=17 terminates under the current frozen v3 solver with SAT or UNSAT; no run allocates any extension variable.

combined_range_checkpoint.note: Finite range only; not an asymptotic theorem.

historical_context_audit.reason: The historical PHP54 gate explicitly used cap_exponent=1. Current frontier uses frozen default cap_exponent=2, so historical extension use under N cap cannot be treated as evidence of extension necessity under N^2 cap.

next_exact_target: Find an upper bound on first legitimate N^2-cap extension use using deterministic legitimate-root scouting, then continue complete layer enumeration toward that bound.
